contents.text: The creative zone is a datapack that adds a new dimension to the world, one where players are in creative mode and able to test any project
To enter it one must first find a creative portal, this structure looks like a portal made of rainbow blocks, with stairs leading up to it. It can be found in basically all overworld biomes.
